rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a situation is regrettable or unfortunate.

example.english: Regrettably, yesterday's match was cancelled because of heavy rain.
example.traditional: 可惜，噚日場波因為落大雨取消咗。
example.jyutping: ho2 sik1 cam4 jat6 coeng4 bo1 jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 ceoi2 siu1 zo2

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts to frame an outcome as regrettable.

example.english: Regrettably, our company was unable to accept your application this time.
example.traditional: 遺憾地，本公司未能接受閣下今次申請。
example.jyutping: wai4 ham6 dei6 bun2 gung1 si1 mei6 nang4 zip3 sau6 gok3 haa6 gam1 ci3 san1 cing2
